frameNote: the countershading harmonic measures 0.214 against the module's 0.30 floor -- a turtle is mottled over its whole surface -- so the floor is lowered to 0.15 and the roll is checked a second way, geometrically.

dorsalEvidence.note: the carapace dome stands further above the axis than the plastron falls below it, and all four flippers hang below: dorsal is +Z

centrelineCorrection.method: the kit's median-of-thick-vertices pass against the two-pass mid-range of the 4th and 96th percentiles over everything neither thin nor nearer a flipper than the rough axis

limbSweepMethod: the largest angle between any two directions the limb points over the cycle, taken from the root joint to the tip joint in world space

mouth.method: geometric: every head vertex casts its own outward normal back into the mesh (Placodus' method), restricted to the head rather than to the kit's front third
mouth.note: the kit's front-third default returns 156 vertices on this body, of which the great majority sit behind y -0.25 -- the gap between a forelimb and the plastron, not a mouth. Restricted to the head the cast returns 25, spread over 0.043 of a body length, which is the beak's own slit.

hingeEnvelopeProbe.note: recorded, not asserted: a point beside a modelled slit is measured against the slit's own wall, whose normal faces into the lumen, so the inside/outside sign is not the skull's. The gape proof is the real check.
